title: Asynchronous LLM Post-Training: Group-Mass Capping and Convergence Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.01896v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves the efficiency of large language model post-training but introduces stale rollouts generated by earlier policies. Theoretical understanding of how this staleness affects convergence and how to mitigate its impact remains limited. We derive a convergence bound for GRPO-style algorithms that explicitly characterizes the tradeoff between the gradient estimator's second moment and bias. For trajectory-level importance-weighted estimators, our analysis shows that once the second moment is uniformly controlled, delay enters the bound through the bias introduced by clipping or rescaling. Guided by this insight, we propose a novel group mass capping GRPO (GMC-GRPO) method, which minimizes a ratio-based bias bound within a class of weighted estimators sharing a common second-moment guarantee. translated_title: 异步大语言模型后训练：组质量上限与收敛性分析
translated_abstract: 异步强化学习（RL）提高了大语言模型后训练的效率，但会引入由较早策略生成的过时 rollout。目前关于这种过时性如何影响收敛以及如何减轻其影响的理论理解仍然有限。我们为 GRPO 风格的算法推导了一个收敛界，明确刻画了梯度估计器二阶矩与偏差之间的权衡。对于轨迹级重要性加权估计器，我们的分析表明，一旦二阶矩得到一致控制，延迟便会通过剪裁或重新缩放所引入的偏差进入收敛界。基于这一见解，我们提出了一种新颖的组质量上限 GRPO（GMC-GRPO）方法，该方法在一类共享相同二阶矩保证的加权估计器中，最小化基于比率的偏差界。我们为异步 GMC-GRPO 建立了收敛保证，并表明与 TIC-GRPO 相比，它……
tldr: 该论文提出了组质量上限GRPO（GMC-GRPO）方法，通过推导异步GRPO算法的收敛界来刻画梯度估计器二阶矩与偏差的权衡，并在共享二阶矩保证的加权估计器类中最小化由过时策略引起的偏差，从而为异步大语言模型后训练建立了收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Group-Mass Capping GRPO (GMC-GRPO), which derives a convergence bound for asynchronous GRPO-style algorithms characterizing the second-moment/bias tradeoff and minimizes the bias induced by stale policies within a class of weighted estimators sharing a uniform second-moment guarantee, establishing convergence guarantees for asynchronous LLM post-training.
